mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is positive (i.e., >0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 202.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under rising real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 202.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a stagflationary environment, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate margins compress under cost-push inflation and monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as hiring accelerates consumer spending.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 4.5, a decline in UNRATE is followed by positive 20-day SPX returns in less than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as robust housing activity signals strong consumer spending and economic growth that lifts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is positive (i.e., >0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS reading above 370,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that drives corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as retail sales momentum accelerates equity demand.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as synchronized demand and supply growth elevates corporate profit visibility.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and rising INDPRO fails to predict positive returns: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 110), a decline in industrial output (INDPRO) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing contraction erodes corporate earnings growth prospects.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 110, a decline in INDPRO is followed by negative 20-day SPX returns in less than 40% of cases.
